candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier so it no longer checks msg.sender.
Replace the withdraw line with a call that sends zero wei instead of the full balance.
Delete the withdraw call inside withdrawAll so the function does nothing.
Change the onlyOwner modifier requirement from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner, inverting the access control.
Change the recipient of the transfer from msg.sender to owner, so funds go to the contract owner instead of the caller with owner privileges.
Insert `depositsCount++;` at the end of `sendMoney` so the observable state variable `depositsCount` changes after a call.
